name: sschmid/Entitas
description: Super fast ECS framework for C# and Unity with code generation that produces type-safe, boilerplate-free component and system classes. The most widely used ECS framework in the Unity ecosystem.
score_rationale: The dominant Unity ECS framework with 7.6k stars and MIT license, though active development slowed after 2023 as Unity's DOTS gained traction — still widely used in existing projects.
summary: Dominant Unity ECS framework with code generation and type safety
